extraction.Name: John Pourier
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent in fee but wanted the land held in trust, but that he signed the receipt that was mailed to him for the reason that he was told that the issuance of the patent had been reported and that the land would be taxed and sold for taxes if they were not paid, whether he took it or not
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I mortgaged the north half of my land to the Newcastle land and Live Stock Co of Newcastle, Wyo for a bunch of cattle, 200 head, and when the cattle were sold they did not bring enough to pay for them and they took the cattle and land to settle it. I still own the South half, but they are after it for taxes, which I am not able to pay.
extraction.Buyer: Newcastle Land and Live Stock Co of Newcastle, Wyoming (foreclosed on north half in settlement of cattle debt, 1918 or 1919)
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: they are after it for taxes, which I am not able to pay
extraction.Occupation/Income: farms what he can, raises a few hogs, and his boys help him
extraction.NOTES: Has a wife and six minor children depending on him for support; in poor health with some kind of liver trouble; has not received any aid from the Government, State or County since the patent was issued; north half of land lost to Newcastle Land and Live Stock Co around 1918 or 1919 when cattle sale proceeds were insufficient to cover debt; south half still owned but threatened with tax sale; sworn October 31, 1928
